ruling.recommended_action: Close the case as no overcharge: the off-route segment was mutually agreed before the deviation; no refund, no fare adjustment.

segment_findings.reason: RD-5: driver proposed the route change via Sims Avenue at 12:24 [F7] and the rider explicitly agreed at 12:24 [F8], both before the segment started at 12:27, and the consent covers this deviation; driver statement [F9] is consistent. RD-4(b) findings [F10][F11] are band 4 (30–39 km/h) and [F12] shows no incidents, so the segment is exempted on consent alone, not on traffic grounds.

rejected_claims.reason: The +3.17 km segment [F3] was agreed by the rider before the deviation [F7][F8] (RD-5), so no unexempted detour exists and there is nothing to refund under RD-2; the traffic facts [F10][F11] are band 4, not the band 1–2 congestion bands.
